blind_notes: Answered all 200 (185 single, 11 multi, 2 numeric, 1 order, 1 matrix) before seeing keys; after correcting my own transcription slips the only disagreement was D-072, where my pick 'Install without access' is not a real install option, so the key 'Install for admins only' stands. Numerics recomputed: T1-057 Dec 15 - Dec 1 = 14; T2-057 80,000 x 25% = 20,000. Spot-checked against Help: T2-028 required fields prefill create-action layouts; Data Import Wizard objects, 18-month field history, report type 4 objects, quick deploy 10 days, sandbox refresh 1/5/29 days all hold.

options_only.score: 122/185 (66%) on the 185 single-answer items (multi/numeric/order/matrix excluded; tools/options_only.py is v1-only, so a v1-shaped copy was made in scratch); K 50/57, S 9/10, G 63/118

findings.issue: Options-only reviewer found the key from form alone (S hit): the key is the only option naming a session or verification feature; the others are obviously unrelated admin tools.
findings.fix: Use distractors of the same family: e.g. 'Permission set with an expiration date', 'Permission set group with a muting permission set', 'Login IP ranges on the profile'.

findings.issue: Options-only reviewer found the key from form alone (S hit): key is the most specific, longest named component.
findings.fix: Make all four specific Lightning components: e.g. 'Related List - Single (standard)', 'Related Lists', 'Related List Quick Links', 'Dynamic Related List - Single'; the stem's filter and sort requirement then decides.

findings.issue: Options-only reviewer found the key from form alone (S hit): three options are fields 'on Account' and the key is the odd one out.
findings.fix: Mix structures: e.g. 'Custom object with a lookup to Account', 'Custom fields on Account per visit', 'Related Activities (tasks) on Account', 'Long Text Area on Account'.

findings.issue: Options-only reviewer found the key from form alone (S hit): only the key contains 'permission set', echoing the stem.
findings.fix: Use permission-set-family distractors: 'Permission set license', 'Muting permission set', 'User access policy' (or rewrite the stem so 'permission set' does not cue).

findings.issue: Options-only reviewer found the key from form alone (S hit): key is the only active, process-describing option ('copies the value at close'), mirroring the stem's 'when it closed'.
findings.fix: Phrase all options as mechanisms: 'Record-triggered flow that writes the field', 'Formula field with PRIORVALUE', 'Roll-up summary with a date filter', 'Default value formula'.

findings.issue: Options-only reviewer found the key from form alone (S hit): the stem says 'no developers' and 'within weeks', so the only no-build option stands out; AgentExchange is also the only branded name.
findings.fix: Give three no-code options: e.g. 'Screen flow with a signature component', 'AgentExchange for an existing app', 'Lightning Object Creator', and keep one coded.

findings.issue: Options-only reviewer found the key from form alone (S hit): the stem's 'without being copied' rules out three options that all copy data; key is the only non-copying one.
findings.fix: Add non-copying distractors: 'Indirect lookup on Account', 'Web tab to the ERP', 'External Services call in a flow'.

findings.issue: Options-only reviewer found the key from form alone (S hit): key is the only non-picklist/text option; 'users add and retire' points straight at an object.
findings.fix: Use relationship distractors: 'Master-detail to a Vendor object', 'External lookup to a Vendor object', 'Dependent picklist of vendors'.

findings.issue: Options-only reviewer found the key from form alone (S hit): distractors are strawmen (scheduled report, escalation rule); key is the only multi-step process tool.
findings.fix: Use plausible flow tools: 'Screen flow with pause elements', 'Approval process with three steps', 'Scheduled-path record-triggered flow', 'Flow orchestration'.

findings.issue: Salesforce Help names Lifecycle Center as 'formerly next-generation DevOps Center' and says the rename applies beginning October 2026; the managed-package DevOps Center remains a separate version. Key is right; the explanation's 'formerly DevOps Center' is slightly loose.
findings.fix: Explanation: 'Lifecycle Center (formerly next-generation DevOps Center, renamed in October 2026)'.
